title: Getting started with matrispace
text: matrispace R package companion MatriSpace. mirrors workflow structure used web app: data input, matrisome profiling, feature analysis. package designed local, reproducible analysis spatial transcriptomics data focus extracellular matrix biology.
code: library(matrispace) library(Seurat) library(ggplot2)

title: Getting started with matrispace
text: can start Seurat object convert SpatialExperiment object convert_spe_to_seurat(). examples testing, package also ships small Seurat object:
code: seurat_obj <- readRDS("path/to/your/spatial_object.rds") test_path <- system.file("testdata", "test_seurat.rds", package = "matrispace") seurat_obj <- readRDS(test_path)

title: Getting started with matrispace
text: prepare_object() runs standard MatriSpace preprocessing steps: gene/signature translation matrisome scoring ECM niche classification ECM niche scoring
code: seurat_obj <- prepare_object(seurat_obj, verbose = TRUE)

title: Getting started with matrispace
text: main profiling functions mirror MatriSpace app workflow. Built-reference objects available directly:
code: seurat_obj <- score_matrisome(seurat_obj) seurat_obj <- annotate_ecm_niches(seurat_obj) seurat_obj <- score_matrisome_pair_coexpression(seurat_obj) data(matrisome_db) data(matrisome_signatures) data(ecm_signatures) data(matrisome_pairs)  nrow(matrisome_db) #> [1] 1029 length(matrisome_signatures) #> [1] 25 names(ecm_signatures) #> [1] "Interstitial" "Basement"     "Vascular"

title: MatriSpace: Spatially-Resolved ECM Gene Expression Patterns
text: spot classified ECM niche (e.g. Interstitial, Basement membrane) using ScType.
code: table(seurat_obj$ecm_niche) #>  #>     Basement_ECM Interstitial_ECM     not.assigned  #>              768              853             1517 ecm_colors <- palette_ecm(unique(seurat_obj$ecm_niche)) coords <- GetTissueCoordinates(seurat_obj) plot_df <- data.frame(   imagecol = coords$imagecol,   imagerow = coords$imagerow,   niche = seurat_obj$ecm_niche )  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = imagecol, y = imagerow, color = niche)) +   geom_point(size = 1.3) +   scale_color_manual(values = ecm_colors, name = "ECM niche") +   scale_y_reverse() +   coord_fixed() +   theme_void() +   labs(title = "ECM niche classification") +   theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5), legend.position = "right")

title: MatriSpace: Spatially-Resolved ECM Gene Expression Patterns
text: LISA (Local Indicators Spatial Association) identifies two features cluster together spatially.  Interpretation:
code: # Analyze COL4A1 vs COL1A1 spatial relationship lisa_results <- compute_lisa(   seurat_obj,   feature1 = "COL4A1", feature1_type = "gene",   feature2 = "COL1A1", feature2_type = "gene" ) lisa_results$id <- seurat_obj$ecm_niche  table(lisa_results$LISA) #>  #> High.High  High.Low  Low.High   Low.Low  #>       539       557       987      1055 plot_lisa(   lisa_results,   ann_col = "id",   f1_name = "COL4A1",   f2_name = "COL1A1" )

title: Identification and Visualization of Spatially-Resolved ECM Gene Expression Patterns
text: R package companion MatriSpace identifying, quantifying, interpreting spatially-resolved extracellular matrix (ECM) gene expression patterns spatial transcriptomics data. use matrispace publications, please cite paper: doi 10.1242/jcs.264998  online MatriSpace app provides interactive interface 240 curated datasets (180 cancer 60 healthy tissue sections) user uploads. matrispace package exposes workflow R scripted analyses, custom modeling, figure generation.

title: Identification and Visualization of Spatially-Resolved ECM Gene Expression Patterns
text: extracellular matrix spatially organized signaling environment shapes tissue architecture, niche identity, inflammation, fibrosis, tumor progression. Spatial transcriptomics enables study ECM gene expression native tissue context, general-purpose workflows built around matrisome organization ECM niches. matrispace brings MatriSpace analytical framework R matrisome-centered analyses can reproduced extended local pipelines.

title: Identification and Visualization of Spatially-Resolved ECM Gene Expression Patterns
text: package follows three stages MatriSpace web application: data input, matrisome profiling, feature analysis.

title: Identification and Visualization of Spatially-Resolved ECM Gene Expression Patterns
text: Accepts Seurat objects directly converts SpatialExperiment objects via convert_spe_to_seurat(). prepare_object() standardizes gene symbols, computes matrisome signatures, classifies spot ECM niche.

title: Identification and Visualization of Spatially-Resolved ECM Gene Expression Patterns
text: score_matrisome() — UCell scores six matrisome categories curated subfamilies (Basement Membrane, Laminins, Matricellular, Mucins, Peri-vascular ECM). annotate_ecm_niches() — ECM niche classification (e.g. Interstitial, Basement membrane), continuous per-spot niche scores. score_matrisome_pair_coexpression() / find_matrisome_pair_enrichment() — spatial co-expression unique heterotypic MatriComDB pairs least one member matrisome gene.

title: Identification and Visualization of Spatially-Resolved ECM Gene Expression Patterns
text: Spatial visualization: plot_spatial_feature(), plot_matrisome(), plot_spatial_blend(), plot_lisa(). Local spatial association: compute_lisa(). Global spatial autocorrelation: compute_morans_i(). find_spatially_corrected_ecm_markers() — within-sample, two-stage Wilcoxon screen followed spaMM Matérn spatial mixed model. find_ecm_de_samples(pseudobulk = TRUE) — cross-sample pseudobulk testing DESeq2, optional cluster blocking adjustment.

title: Calculate spatial matrisome-pair co-expression scores — score_matrisome_pair_coexpression
text: $$Score_{spot} = \sqrt{Gene2_{spot}} \times \sum_{neighbors} \sqrt{Gene1_{neighbor}}$$ Pair members alphabetically ordered scoring reciprocal rows collapse one stable feature name. Homomeric rows excluded. Product structure: score non-zero pair members detected relevant spot neighborhood.
